notes.title: v1.0.5 Patch
notes.notes:
[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[list]
[*] Add a new barrier to all the "GASTRONOMER" minigame maps, to stop the GASTRONOMER from flying off into the edges of space to stop players from killing them (after accumulating a few points).
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fix an issue from v1.0.3 in the "BERRY BARRAGE" minigame, where players couldn't land on the orbiting planets.
[*] Fix a visual issue with Prism's head from v1.0.3 when they respawn after dying
[*] Fix some soft locks in the menu after playing a single game
[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]

[list]
[*] Credited a few more people we missed who worked on the game, in the credits screen
[*] Optimised some gravity code. Only noticabled on systems with very low hardware specs.
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h1]Previous changes[/h1]
[h2]v1.0.3[/h2]

[h3]Additions[/h3]

[list]
[*] Add new languages: Italian, Korean and Traditional Chinese.
[*] Added some missing roles and names from the development team to the Credits screen.
[*] (Single player) Add the ability to skip the dialogue during the medals presentation after a single player mission is completed.
[/list]
[h3]Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] The likelihood of minigames "Gastronomer" and "Puff Panic" to appear earlier was slightly increased.
[*] Adjust the feeling of gravity for the thrown bombs in the minigame "Gravapult"
[*] In the minigame "Gastronomer", add a label above the Gastronomer's head that appears when the Gastronomer eats players and scores points (+1, +2, etc)
[*] Allow pausing in multiplayer during the countdown
[*] (Single player) Edited some levels in Spark’s single player challenges to make them more achievable
[*] (Single player) Changed some time requirements for a few single player missions.
[*] (Single player) During the dialogue at the beginning of a level, we changed “Hold to skip”, with a single press “Skip dialogue”
[*] (Single player) Hid the "Coming soon" options for now. We want to update the game with new content in the single player campaign. But can't guarantee how soon we'll be able to do that.
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fix the message on the welcome screen that mentioned wishlisting.
[*] Fix localization issues that were sprinkled around the game. In some cases, certain labels weren't being localized. In other cases, the font wasn't being updated on some labels.
[*] Fix some bugs in the minigame "Event Horizon". One bug sometimes caused notifications to appear too often on the right of the screen when ghosts would die. Another buy caused planets to sometimes be placed on top of one another.
[*] Fix a music playback issue in single player when launching or being asked to launch the tutorial.
[*] Change the method of rendering character outlines- it is more efficient.
[*] The glyphs in the tooltips within the practice area change depending on the players that have dropped in.
[*] Fix a soft lock that can happen in the single player menu if you spam the back button (to return to the title screen)
[*] More small bugs and optimisations
[/list]

notes.title: We have a Release Date + Next Fest
notes.notes:
Hey Galaxy Gamers,

We cannot believe we’re getting to announce this. But it’s real, we’re announcing our release date today for Which Way Up: Galaxy Games.

And that date is… March 27! 🥳 🚀🎊 ☄️ 🎉 (check out our new trailer, below)

[previewyoutube=sFrIW1_mMa8;full][/previewyoutube]

Also, a month prior to launch, we’ll be taking part in the Steam Next Fest, which takes place from February 24 – March 3.

[h1]Updated Demo[/h1]
And when February 24 comes around, you won’t just be playing the same demo. We’ve been hard at work on polishing it to within an inch of its life, as well as adding:
[list]
[*] Single player content (some content locked in the demo)
[*] NEW Game Setup menu! (play just one mini-game at a time)
[*] Game customisation options

[/list]

notes.title: Wholesome Games & NEW Demo Update [v0.7.4]
notes.notes:
Hello Galaxy Gamers!

Oh wow, we've got a big one for you this time!

First of all, before we get into the nitty-gritty, we're going to be doing a Kickstarter really soon! We'll provide another update around that, but it'd mean the world to us if you were to click the waitlist button and support us when it's live. [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/turtle-flip/which-way-up-galaxy-games?ref=dvp7xz]You can do that by clicking here.[/url]

But more about the game itself, we're going to be featured in the upcoming Wholesome Games Steam Celebration!

And secondly, we're updating the demo!

[h1]Wholesome Games Steam Celebration[/h1]

We've loved everything Wholesome Games has done and being able to take part with our own little game is such an honour!

Which Way Up: Galaxy Games will be situated alongside plenty of amazing cozy games going around at the moment, and we're so thrilled!

The event will kick off on August 15 at 1pm ET and will run for a week until August 21.

We hope you have a wonderful time playing some cozy demos, nabbing some great discounts and playing our game! If you've played our demo before, be sure to take this opportunity to download the update and try to spot what has changed.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames]Wholesome Games Steam Celebration[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43684091/4dad857413119596ffc28fc59fef396abfbc2d61.png[/img]

And we're not just taking part with nothing new to show...

[h1]NEW Demo Update (v0.7.4)[/h1]

[h2]What's new[/h2]
[list]
[*] Introducing PIPS! Pips are a how the Celestial Sprites gather and store their unique power. They are going to be scattered through a number of Galaxy Games. They are now making appearances in Comet Collect, Gravapult and Constellation Catch (with their eyes closed). They have also snuck into the main menu and the Academy!
[*] We introduced new spawning and death visual effects, so it is more obvious where players are spawning and when they die offscreen.
[*] The bouncy planets have been turned into pink jelly and scattered thoroughly throughout the "Overload" Galaxy Game.
[*] The visuals for ice planets have been improved. Making them look more like ice! You will also slide on ice faster when landing on an ice planet!
[*] Boost Pads have been improved with better visuals and sound effects. They are also making more appearances across the galaxy! Like in Event Horizon, Star Ring and Overload.
[*] Platforming has an updated "feel". The fall speed is slower, but the max. fall speed is higher! You will also break into a sprint much sooner when running perpendicular to gravity for long enough.
[*] Bouncing off the ground has been improved, so you should be impossible to get stuck in an infite loop of bouncing between planets.
[*] You will now daze or stun a player for a short time if you land on their head.
[*] Orbit had a makeover and Sprout became a little more lime coloured!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43684091/154c158f192a7dfd5ba6ac415b3317aa6c8f5d37.gif[/img]

[b]Galaxy Games[/b]
[list]
[*] [b][Overload][/b] We fixed a few rare bugs that could cause the game state to be stuck in Overload. Nobody would have the bomb and the game wouldn't couldn't conclude.
[*] [b][Overload][/b] There is a lot of jelly around the outside of Overload maps. We want you to stay close to your competitors! But obviously, not too close.
[*] [b][Event Horizon][/b] We limited the distance the black hole can travel across the screen and we slow it down as it gets further to the right. This increased the theoretical maximum distance you can travel.
[*] [b][Event Horizon][/b] We fixed some player spawning bugs which were causing players to spawn inside the black hole once it was very far across the screen.
[*] [b][Constellation Catch][/b] The stars now morph into our PIP characters (without their eyes). We hope this will help with accessibility, so the silhouette can help players discern who owns a star without relying on colour.
[*] [b][Comet Collect][/b] We introduced a new feature we are very excited about; goal magnetism! If a ball flies towards and is close enough to a goal area, it will be magnetised to that goal! It is now much easier to collect comets. But be careful about collecting comets for other players!
[*] [b][Gravapult][/b] We fixed a number of bugs making it hard to throw bombs while you are standing on the ground. The bombs are also affected by gravity in a slightly different way now.
[*] [b][Gravapult][/b] Our new PIPs are the center of attention in Gravapult. Your PIPs are the guardians of the planets you are protecting. Be sure to treat them well and push the bombs off and away your planets.
[/list]

[h1]Thank You For Your Support[/h1]

We really appreciate everyone's support so far and we can't wait to kick things up a notch really soon!

Until then, we hope you enjoy the updated demo and we cannot wait to see people go hands-on with it.

If you do play the demo and want to post about it online on social media, please show us your fun times by tagging us @WhichWayUpGame.

With love,
The Turtle Flip team

notes.title: June Update - Still Chipping Away ⛳
notes.notes:
Hey Galaxy Gamers,

June already, that’s crazy! Even more crazy to think that we’re likely within 12 months of launch. Yep. I’m fine.

This month’s update is going to be short and sweet, letting you know that we are hard at work creating some new mini-games as well as planning out the highly requested single-player mode. 

But before we get into all that, be sure to follow us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/whichwayupgame/]Instagram[/url] for some more hilarious memes like this one!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43684091/723a32e2c631979b4d4838c134fef5ddf799d171.png[/img]

[h1]Fore! (that's a golf term)[/h1]
While we’ve teased it here and there, we’re finally ready to show you a sneaky little GIF of a new mini-game called “Hole in One”.

The GIF below is a work-in-progress, but we’re excited to show you more as things come along.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43684091/0334aeecd5f876a7ea157822c13b7bba7e079bf4.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43684091/675e0dbbab104c02cf1d75657069a9b37cc600d2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43684091/8f0e05e4f1f8e3811d4341215caad1a4c83b8c34.png[/img]

Well, we listened and we’ve started working on a single-player mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43684091/5e15c85bbb9820f37c193234679d2a71a5c98806.png[/img]

notes.title: May Update - An Entire Generation of Games
notes.notes:
Hey Galaxy Gamers,

We’re back with a brand new update for May!

We had a wonderful time at Generation Games in Sydney where, for the first time, players went hands-on with our brand new mini-game Nebula Nab. 

We’ve also dabbled in making some physical merchandise, like fun shiny stickers and adorable crocheted characters.

But before we get into all that, be sure to follow us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/whichwayupgame/]Instagram[/url] for some ripping memes like this one!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43684091/205656c544febe189cb189ec8c3f9ed639935beb.png[/img]

[h1]Nabbing the Nebulas at Generation Games[/h1]
We teased it in the April Steam update, but last month at Generation Games, we let players go hands-on with Nebula Nab, our brand new mini game, for the very first time.

And it was a hit!

And so was our little panel talk we did 🙂

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43684091/0bd738435095b08a5f56283ff9fe9d672d829d5f.png[/img]

In Nebula Nab, each player must jump around and collect little grey sprites called Pips; doing so will turn them into little pip versions of your chosen Celestial. Once collected, it is up to that player to bring them back to the base in the middle to collect points.

However, watch out for your opponents, as if they run into your pips before you can get them back to the middle, they’ll become grey again. 

The mini game was praised for its sense of risk and reward. Collecting more pips in a single go can collect you more points, but it also leaves you more vulnerable to opponents.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43684091/bf22d8f6529776ac743064483765b75a30e4492d.gif[/img]

[h1]Crochet Creativity[/h1]
We’ve been wanting to get creative with our characters for a long time, and while we’ve experimented with a few bips and bobs here and there, we ended up getting the crochet hook out.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43684091/ecdc2d699ed99fdcf2dd5cdbc1876e38da6b5d36.png[/img]

We took these little crocheted pips with us to Generation Games and they were absolutely adored by players and attendees. 

The pips themselves even had a go of the game [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@whichwayupgame/video/7360174808312581384?lang=en]over on our TikTok[/url] when they got the chance.

[h1]Have You Played Our Demo Yet?[/h1]
If you’ve been eager to give Which Way Up: Galaxy Games a go, you can actually do it right now! The demo is available now and it features SIX Galactic Games for you to play with family and friends.

And if you post about it on social media, please be sure to tag us @WhichWayUpGames. We’d love to see you have fun with our game; it truly makes all the hard work worthwhile!

We’re going to try to provide updates here once per month, but for more consistent updates, you can follow us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/whichwayupgame/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@whichwayupgame]TikTok[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/WhichWayUpGame/]Twitter[/url] (all @WhichWayUpGame).

And we have plenty more ideas for merchandise, but we’d also like to know what you’d want to see. So to have your say, come [url=https://discord.gg/9tM3kCECVf]join our Discord[/url].

With love,

The Turtle Flip team

notes.title: An Overdue Progress Update- April 2024
notes.notes:
Hey Galaxy Gamers,

Thank you everyone for your patience! We know we’ve been quiet since the Steam Remote Play Together Fest, but rest assured, the team has been hard at work.

While we’ve been active on our socials, we’ve neglected to provide an update here on Steam, so we’re going to do our best to provide updates here more frequently moving forward.

[h1]Name Change[/h1]
That’s right, it’s not a trick of the Mandela Effect, we have changed the title of the game.

We changed it from Which Way Up: Space Olympics as we realised we didn’t want the International Olympic Committee coming after us for trademark infringement.

However, in hindsight, we quickly grew fond of the new title, and we hope you will too!

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43684091/d61f3491c846e2ea3bccd716f28e895370b8869c.png[/img]

[h1]We’ve Been Social[/h1]
Two weeks ago in Melbourne, Victoria, we had an absolute blast at The Game Expo showcasing our game to attendees.

We received some wonderful feedback, snapped some fun photos and made plenty of friends!

On April 20-21, we’ll be stepping out of our dimly lit basements to be social once more at Generation Games in Sydney. If you happen to be attending, please come by to say hello and give Which Way Up: Galaxy Games a go. And if you haven’t got tickets yet, [url=https://generationgames.com.au/]they’re still available here[/url].

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43684091/bc18402a80a3336638a252ff6dc515de24015b00.jpg[/img]

[h1]What About the Game?![/h1]
Don’t fret; we’ve been hard at work on some new Galaxy Events, whilst taking on the feedback we’ve received to improve the existing ones.

You may be wondering what these new cute little characters are in the artwork above, their called PIPS! While we’re not quite ready to give away any specifics, here are a couple of GIFs below to give you some ideas…

[h3]Galactic game #7- IN DEVELOPMENT[/h3]
[i]Look at those little Pips![/i]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43684091/6dfd30c1c56ccbfa2b14cb795d534eaa1a6c3483.gif[/img]

[h3]Galactic game #8- IN DEVELOPMENT[/h3]
[i]Ever wanted to play golf in space?[/i]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43684091/c5fd55062b8a2574038ecf1209ec5e6792a059b6.gif[/img]

[h1]Have You Played Our Demo Yet?[/h1]
If you’ve been eager to give Which Way Up: Galaxy Games a go, you can actually do it right now! The demo is available now and it features SIX Galactic Games for you to play with family and friends.

And if you post about it on social media, please be sure to tag us @WhichWayUpGames. We’d love to see you have fun with our game; it truly makes all the hard work worthwhile!

[h1]Thank you[/h1]
On behalf of the entire team at Turtle Flip Studio, we want to thank everyone for their ongoing support and we cannot wait to continue sharing updates on our game.

We’re going to try to provide updates here once per month, but for more consistent updates, you can follow us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/whichwayupgame/]Instagram[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@whichwayupgame]TikTok[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/WhichWayUpGame/]Twitter[/url] (all @WhichWayUpGame), or [url=https://discord.gg/9tM3kCECVf]join our Discord[/url].

With love,

The Turtle Flip team
